notes.H15 cross-check: the cusp is NOT smooth: singular exactly at the origin; the class still equals L
notes.KILL 1 CERTIFIED: [Y_1] = L^4 + L^2 by two independent stratifications, so chi_c(Y_1) = 2. chi_c is motivic and multiplicative with chi_c(A^r) = 1, so chi_c(Y_1 x A^r) = 2 != 1 = chi_c(A^{4+r}) for every r >= 0. Hence Y_1 x A^r is NOT isomorphic to A^{4+r} for any r -- the kill covers every stabilisation.
notes.KILL 2 CERTIFIED: a variable of a polynomial ring has nowhere-vanishing differential; W has a whole line of critical points, and adjoining further variables leaves that line (times an affine space) critical. So W is not a variable of C^[5], nor stably. Independent of KILL 1.
notes.KILL 3 CERTIFIED (identification, prior: Y_1 = Q_{(3,1), z^2-1/4} EXACTLY, in ADO's printed conventions (arXiv:2112.08241 Ex. 4.2.5). With n = 2 and deg P = 2 their result gives A^1-homotopy type (P^1 smash P^1)^{wedge (deg P - 1)} = P^1 smash P^1, complex realisation S^4 -- NOT contractible, so not A^4. The fourfold and its homotopy type are ADO's PRIOR ART; what is ours is its role in the square.
notes.Q-stratum {q = 0}: p(1+p) = 0, exactly T: the two roots p = 0 and p = -1
notes.Y_1's units and class group: not computed this visit; recorded rather than guessed. Neither is needed for the three kills.

notes.the three kills are INDEPENDENT: KILL 1 is motivic (chi_c), KILL 2 is differential (critical locus), KILL 3 is homotopical (ADO). Any one suffices; KILL 1 alone also covers all stabilisations.
